comment: ENGINEER-STATED GOLD FACTS for GM-114a (bilge system). These live ONLY in tests/ — never in any pipeline prompt or code (gold-blind rule). Source: engineer red-pen 2026-07-22.

facts.claim: Local pump switch: cables 1 and 2 of a multi-core lead to T/S C terminals 48 and 49 (they are CABLES, not pins), and are part of the remote switches
facts.expect: 48 and 49 on T/S C reachable from the local switch multicore

facts.claim: ONYX remote switch is XA11 terminal 32
Valve MOTOR activation terminals come from plug C: 9/10 lazarette, 18/19 aft, 26/27 engine room, 34/35 fwd, 42/43 sail locker (the T/S C terminals previously named were plug D signal lights)
facts.expect: these pairs drive the valve motors, from plug C

facts.claim: Re1-Re5 take their + from T/S B FUSED terminals 8,9,10,11,12 respectively
facts.expect: each relay coil + from its T/S B fused terminal

facts.claim: Re1 negative: T/S C terminal 11 -> wire 1 of the multi-core -> plug C pin 1; with S20 closed the - comes from plug C terminal 12
Plug C pin 11 is the NEGATIVE for all indicators and for the main pump switch relay Re6; pin 12 is not used
